The '''''Atawar''''' was an [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] that was used during the [[Sepan Civil War]] by the [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]]. The Escort Shuttle was part of a defense force for [[Science Station Youst]], an [[XQ1 Platform]] that was officially a science station, but was also secretly a weapons lab. The station fell under attack by [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] forces as retaliation for an attack on a convoy by Dimok raiders. The station called for assistance and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the command of [[Harkov]] arrived to [[Sepan campaign|intervene]]. The Escort Shuttle was destroyed in the battle, likely by Ripoblus forces.
